features.name: Supabase + Vercel MVP scaffold
features.description: Static Vercel app with Supabase Auth/Postgres/RLS/RPC, seed data, login, matches, betting, history, leaderboard, and admin dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Supabase schema defines the MVP data model
Static frontend can call Supabase directly
Vercel function can create admin-provisioned player accounts
features.notes: Preferred route now requires no local npm/Python install.

features.name: Provider sync implementation
features.description: Implement scheduled API-FOOTBALL and The Odds API sync with quota-aware caching.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures and teams sync from API-FOOTBALL
Odds provider status and mapped markets are recorded without exposing keys
Player UI shows odds source, bookmaker when available, and provider update freshness
Admin can override match-market and outright multiplier, lock time, and open/closed state with audit logging
Match statistics sync fills corners/cards settlement data with quota caps
Sync runs record request counts and failures
Data source and market reference doc exists
features.notes: Fixtures and capped match statistics sync implemented as Vercel Function. The Odds API h2h/draw_no_bet/totals mapping updates match_markets and odds_snapshots; outrights update outright_markets when team names match confidently. Live API-key verification is still required.

features.name: Production deployment
features.description: Deploy vercel-static with Supabase env vars and a configured first admin account.
acceptance_criteria: Supabase schema and seed scripts have run
Vercel Root Directory is vercel-static
Service role key is only configured as a Vercel server env var
No-install deploy checklist, deployment verifier, launch smoke test, and env example are available
features.notes: Checklist, env example, and deployment verifier are ready; live Supabase/Vercel deployment still needs a deployment URL or callable Vercel integration in this Codex session.

features.name: No-install static verification
features.description: Provide a local verification gate and Vercel health check for the Supabase/Vercel static deploy path without installing packages.
acceptance_criteria: Verification checks required static deploy files
Verification checks JavaScript syntax and JSON config
Verification checks env template and Supabase SQL contract tokens
Verification checks common hardcoded secret patterns
Verification checks obvious encoding issues
Admin can see Vercel environment readiness without exposing secret values
features.notes: Run `node scripts/verify-static.mjs` before deploying to Vercel; `/api/health` and the Admin Dashboard verify env presence after deploy.

features.name: Prediction bonus scoring
features.description: Leaderboard uses settled net points plus accuracy bonuses while wallet balance remains pure stake/payout accounting.
acceptance_criteria: Bets store prediction_bonus separately from wallet payout
Settlement assigns market-specific bonuses for winning predictions
Draw-no-bet draws refund stake without awarding prediction bonus
Leaderboard score includes net points plus bonuses
Wallet ledger records stake deductions, winning payouts, and void refunds
Reports and CSV exports expose bonus and net components
features.notes: Correct score, tournament winner, 1X2, totals/BTTS, corners, and cards each have separate bonus values.

features.name: Admin audit logs
features.description: Important user/admin actions are written to audit_logs and visible/exportable from Admin Dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Bet placements write audit logs
Admin single-bet void/refund actions write audit logs
Wallet adjustments write audit logs
Market multiplier/open-state changes write audit logs
User creation and password reset write audit logs
Match and tournament settlements write audit logs
Admin can view and export audit logs
features.notes: Implemented through Supabase RPC inserts, Vercel service-role function inserts, Admin Dashboard table, and CSV export.

features.name: Admin reporting and CSV exports
features.description: Admin can inspect player performance, market performance, recent predictions, wallet ledger, and export reports as CSV.
acceptance_criteria: Admin report includes player wallet, score, accuracy, ROI, profit/loss, bonus points, open bets, and settled bets
Admin market report includes bets, stake, profit/loss, bonus points, score, accuracy, and ROI by market
Admin can inspect recent predictions across users
Admin can filter recent predictions, wallet ledger, audit logs, and CSV exports by user/date range
Admin can void/refund a single placed bet with a reason
Admin can inspect wallet ledger entries
Admin can export leaderboard, user/market reports, bets, wallet ledger, and audit log CSV files
features.notes: Implemented in the static Supabase app using admin RLS reads, admin_user_report/admin_market_report views, and client-side CSV generation.

features.name: Tournament winner market
features.description: Players can bet on the World Cup champion and admin can settle final outright results.
acceptance_criteria: Schema stores tournament winner selections separately from match markets
Players can place tournament winner bets from the app
Admin can manage tournament winner multipliers, lock time, and open/closed state
Admin can settle tournament winner bets
Outright bets appear in history, reports, and leaderboard scoring
features.notes: Implemented with `outright_markets`, `place_outright_bet`, `admin_update_outright_market`, and `settle_tournament_winner`; bets still settle through the shared `bets` table.

features.name: Legacy FastAPI scaffold
features.description: FastAPI + React/Vite scaffold retained as an alternate architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Only resume if Supabase limits become a blocker
features.notes: Supabase + Vercel is cheaper and simpler for MVP.
